subject: maths
question: The average attendance at a cricket stadium increased by 15% in 2012 in comparison to the previous year. If 2160 more people came to see the matches in 2012, how many came in 2011?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** 15% = 3/20, 3 increases on 20.

⇒ 3 Units = 2160

⇒ 1 Unit = 720

⇒ 20 Units = 14400

∴ The average attendance in 2011 was 14400.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Calculation:**

Let,

The average attendance in 2011 was = x

The average attendance in 2012 increased by 15%

That value is 2160 more than the previous year

so,

⇒ (x × 15) / 100 = 2160

⇒ x × 15 = 216000

⇒ x = 14400

**∴ The average attendance in 2011 was 14400**.
